card.name: Words leading up to 'happen' or 'occurs'
card.fires_on: Small words right before a verb meaning to happen or occur, as in 'less likely to happen again' or 'if this happens'. It also fires on 'If' or 'this' that open a clause about an event occurring.

modes.label: Before 'happen again'
modes.description: Words in a phrase about stopping an event from happening again.

modes.label: If/this before 'occurs' or 'happens'
modes.description: A clause opener that refers back to an event, followed by happens, occurs or is seen.
modes.example: Call your pharmacist if<< this>> happens.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words meaning 'happen' or 'occur', including Chinese ones.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before 'happens' or 'occurs', when the text refers to an event that might take place.
